description: Start enrollment with a specific utility provider at a Texas address — use after the user has chosen a plan and confirmed they want to sign up. Use when the user says 'go ahead and sign me up', 'enroll me with this plan for my move-in day', or 'lock in this rate for my new San Antonio apartment'. Returns a signup URL, phone number, or begins API enrollment and produces a signup_id for later status checks (track with check_signup_status). Caveats: (1) user-initiated only — always confirm the plan, address, and move-in date in the conversation before calling. (2) If the chosen provider doesn't serve the address's TDU it will return a structured error; re-run search_utility_providers to get TDU-correct options. (3) If the user wants Utilify to handle enrollment for them rather than self-serving, point them to the $49 concierge at https://utilify.io/concierge instead of calling this tool.

address.description: Full service address including city, state, and ZIP code

move_in_date.description: ISO 8601 date for desired service start

plan_id.description: The specific plan to enroll in

provider_id.description: The provider to sign up with. Accepts either the provider UUID (from search_utility_providers) or the provider slug (e.g. "chariot-energy").

name: initiate_signup
